root_cause: The production locale verifier required a classical Playwright navigation event even though the public language control can complete through client-side routing/state changes. The live /en/prijzen route and translated content were valid, but waitForURL timed out.
decision: Verify locale switching by the resulting canonical pathname plus document.documentElement.lang after activating the visible language control, rather than coupling proof to a navigation event.
prevention: treat URL state plus html lang as the user-visible locale contract
support link and select language controls
retain translated-content assertions after the state transition
do not weaken live production assertions or bypass locale routing
dismiss the canonical cookie dialog through its visible deny control before exercising language navigation in production browser proof

evidence.production_failure: cookie dialog intercepted pointer events on the visible English language link

canary: Production Source Snapshot pricing/i18n browser proof
